from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.task =~ /cpu0/ or r.task == "IDLE0" or r.task == "main"
    or r.task =~ /rtcontrol/ or r.task == "tiT"
    or r.task =~ /emac/ or r.task =~ /esp_timer/
    or r.task =~ /calib/ or r.task =~ /ipc0/)
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, task: r.task, display: r.task}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "task", "display"])

from(bucket: "local_system")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.task =~ /cpu1/ or r.task == "IDLE1"
    or r.task =~ /comms/ or r.task =~ /monitor/
    or r.task =~ /uros/ or r.task =~ /mqtt/
    or r.task =~ /ptp/ or r.task =~ /tel_/

  |> group(columns: ["task"])

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "net")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["interface"] == "eth0" or r["interface"] == "wlan0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes_recv" or r["_field"] == "bytes_sent")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (r._value * 8.0) / 1000000.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.interface + "_" + r._field }))
  |> yield(name: "velocidad_mbps")

import "array"

total = from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "total")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

freeval = from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "available")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

containers_sum = from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "procstat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "memory_rss")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

containers = from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "procstat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "memory_rss")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "pattern"])
  |> group(columns: ["pattern"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1048576.0,
     pattern: if r.pattern == "influxd" then "influxdb"
              else if r.pattern == "micro_ros_agent" then "uros_agent"
              else r.pattern }))
  |> rename(columns: {pattern: "container"})
  |> group()

others_val = (float(v: total[0]) - float(v: freeval[0]) - float(v: containers_sum[0])) / 1048576.0
extra = array.from(rows: [
  {container: "Free", _value: float(v: freeval[0]) / 1048576.0},
  {container: "Others", _value: others_val}
])

union(tables: [containers, extra])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "docker_container_cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "usage_percent")
  |> group(columns: ["container_name"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "container_name"])

disk = from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "disk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "used" or r["_field"] == "free")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["path"] == "/")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1073741824.0 }))
  |> group()
  |> yield()
